newsitem.title: ITALY: Benetton sales to reach 5 trln lire in 2000.
newsitem.headline: Benetton sales to reach 5 trln lire in 2000.

text.p: Italian clothing group Benetton is aiming to see a rise in sales by 2000 to five trillion lire following its acquisition of Benetton Sportsystem earlier this month, analysts said on Thursday.
This followed a Benetton investors roadshow on Wednesday in Milan attended by analysts, at which the group said its return on sales would be above 13 percent in 2000.

Analysts added that Benetton had said that group sales in 1997 would be 4.3 trillion lire from 2.9 trillion lire in 1996. Its debt/equity ratio would be 30 percent in 1997 and fall to 10 percent in 2000. Group profits were set to rise around seven percent in 1997.
At the investor roadshow with group vice-president Gilberto Benetton were managing director Carlo Gilardi and finance director Gianfranco Bottini.
For Sportsystem, Benetton said it had an objective of reaching 1.5 trillion lire of sales and a return on sales of 10 percent in 2000.

Earlier this month, Benetton said it was buying Benetton Sportsystem from the Benetton family holding company Edizione Holding. Benetton's shares are listed on the Milan bourse but it is 71.3 percent controlled by Edizione.
